newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London weak, Dow seen lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London weak, Dow seen lower.

text.p: U.S. shares were mostly lower in quiet morning trade as European investors took profits in the aftermath of Wall Street's recent strong advance, dealers said.

"We're seeing some mild profit-taking across the board which is hardly surprising," one dealer said. "I would think the Dow will open five to eight points lower and remain weak during today's session. It should be a day for profit-taking."
Intel, a star performer on Tuesday, was down $1/4 at $94 after rising $5-5/8 in New York. Other high-techonolgy shares were also under pressure.
Texas Instruments was down $3/8 at $50 while IBM eased $1/4 at $123-1/4.
Profit-takers also targeted the tobacco sector following press reports that tobacco companies had allegedly destroyed or hid sensitive documents dealing with scientific research into smoking.
Philip Morris, which rose $2 on Tuesday, was down $1/2 at $93-1/2 while RJR Nabisco eased $1/4 to $26-3/4.
The S&P 500 December futures contract was down 0.20 at 689.75 by 0950 GMT while the December T-bond dipped 2/32 to 108-3/32.
